skills.name: Like-denominator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that have a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Rewrite unlike-denominator fractions as equivalent fractions with a common denominator.

skills.name: Mixed and whole number handling
skills.definition: Represent and align whole numbers and mixed numbers so their whole and fractional parts can be subtracted appropriately.

skills.name: Regrouping for subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup or rename a whole-number unit as fractional parts when the minuend fraction is smaller than the subtrahend fraction.
